about_the_game:
Welcome to OAsys!

A new extreme sport is taking the valley by storm, and what better way to promote it than with a tournament? You play as The Pilot and their army of speedbots—built to run, crash, and start all over again in a frenetic time-trial race! All thanks to our sponsors, of course.



Competition Above All!

Take the top spot on the leaderboard! Other contenders want the #1 rank, but you’re more relentless. Replay the level as many times as needed to secure the highest score—so don’t hold back. Show your robot fury to the competition and dominate the leaderboard!

Master Speedbot!

This exceptionally dangerous sport is practiced only by robots designed for this purpose. Very few make it to the finish line, as countless obstacles stand in their way. Will you be the first champion of this Speedbot Tournament?

A Breathtaking Valley!

The races take place in a sprawling landscape, blending natural and industrial settings with a solarpunk-inspired art direction. You’ll die often—but what a stunning valley to behold as you do!

Game Features

- Race through 10 levels with increasing difficulty.

- Improve your mastery of the character and the environment!

- Use gameplay elements to optimize your path and get the best time!

 - Survive obstacles during your run!

- Climb the Leaderboard and compare your scores with friends!

- Earn as many Medals as possible ! aim higher and higher !

Game Modes

- A main campaign mode!

- A "level chaining" mode: If you die, you go back to the first level!

- Each level comes with challenges to complete ! can you finish it 100%?

  • OS: Windows 10

  • Graphics: nvidia 1060 GTX 6 GB

short_description: A fast-paced competitive racing game set in a solarpunk universe. You play as a speedbot, an athlete competing in a spectacular and perilous new tournament filled with robots, lasers, and a healthy dose of style !
